research.name: Mercury
research.note: Live coding language for electronic music in Max whose 30-line editor is drawn as large text over full-screen 3D visuals.

effects: code editor rendered as large monospace text directly over full-screen 3D visuals
editor capped at 30 numbered lines so all code stays visible to the audience
cursor line marked with >> in the gutter and a <== arrow at the caret
